What happens here

  1. AccumulationThe source injects azimuthal field Bφ. No axial momentum is injected.
  2. AccelerationThe magnetic pressure gradient pushes plasma away from the midplane.
  3. CollimationAzimuthal magnetic tension constricts the flow; the ambient medium confines its expansion.

Assess settling using the mass flux. It is not assigned by a timer.

Real MHD evolution in simplified geometry. The central engine is prescribed; black-hole gravity and accretion are not computed.
MODEL / METHOD / LIMITS

Honest physics.
Explicit approximations.

This solves an initial-boundary-value problem in Newtonian ideal magnetohydrodynamics. It is not a full black-hole jet simulation: it reproduces magnetic launching and collimation in a magnetic-tower model.

Equations solved

∂tρ + ∇·(ρv) = Sρ
∂t(ρv) + ∇·[ρvv + (p + B²/2)I − BB] = 0
∂tE + ∇·[(E + p + B²/2)v − (v·B)B] = SE
∂tB − ∇×(v×B) + ∇ψ = SB
∂tψ + cₕ² ∇·B = −ψ/τ
p = (γ−1)[E − ρv²/2 − B²/2],  γ = 5/3

Cylindrical coordinates (r,z), ∂φ = 0, with all three components of v and B. Geometric terms include radial tension −Bφ²/r. A finite-volume Rusanov scheme uses piecewise-linear minmod reconstruction, first-order Euler time integration, an explicit CFL of 0.27 (summed over directions), and GLM cleaning of ∇·B. The scheme is diffusive and does not resolve fine structure. Grid convergence has not been established; speeds depend appreciably on resolution.

Initial and boundary conditions

Domain: 0 ≤ r/L₀ ≤ 12, −24 ≤ z/L₀ ≤ 24. Uniform stationary atmosphere: ρ = ρambient, p = 0.08ρambient, Bz = 0.18, Br = Bφ = 0. The radial face has zero area on the axis, with regular cylindrical source terms. Outer boundaries have zero gradients: an approximate outflow condition that is not perfectly nonreflecting.

SBφ = 8 A (1−e^(−t/1.5)) r e^(−r²/2)
      × tanh(z/0.45) e^(−z²/1.5)
Sρ  = 0.025 e^(−r²/2−z²/1.5)

Bφ and its magnetic energy are added consistently at each step; injected mass is stationary, with p/ρ = 0.08. This is an externally prescribed engine, not a derivation of the Blandford–Znajek mechanism. Switching it off sets both sources to zero. The equations contain no gravity, rotating accretion disk, horizon, or Kerr metric. The central dark ring marks the unresolved engine; it is not a computed black-hole shadow.

What is rendered

The volume is obtained by revolving the computed slice about the axis and integrating illustrative emission along each ray. Brightness ∝ ρ√(p/ρ) max(B²−B₀², 0), with B₀ = 0.18 and dynamic-range compression, is an artistic indicator, not a spectrum or radiative-transfer calculation. There is no lensing or Doppler boosting. Color ranges are fixed and values above the upper bound saturate. Field lines are overlaid without occlusion. Glow and the star background are decorative. In the slice view, color represents the selected local quantity.

Field lines are integrated using dr/ds = Br/|B|, dz/ds = Bz/|B|, dφ/ds = Bφ/(r|B|). Their number is arbitrary; these are instantaneous field lines, not particle trajectories. Velocity arrows are computed from ρv/ρ.

Diagnostics and limitations

t₀ = L₀/v₀; the scale is arbitrary and speed is not expressed in c. The model applies for v ≪ c. Energies use the volume element 2πr dr dz. Mass flux has units ρ₀v₀L₀². *∇·B error = max[Δx |∇·B| / (|B|+10⁻⁵)], estimated by central differences excluding boundary cells. This is not the exact discrete divergence of the numerical method.

Floors ρ ≥ 10⁻⁵ and p ≥ 10⁻⁷ prevent inadmissible states. Energy added by the pressure floor is reported below. GLM, boundary outflow, and mass and field sources mean domain energy cannot be treated as conserved. Once the jet head leaves the domain, the subsequent view depends on boundary conditions. Axisymmetry excludes the three-dimensional kink instability. MRI, particle kinetics, and physical resistivity are not modeled. A quasi-steady state is not guaranteed.

For the full problem

A validated GRMHD code (such as AthenaK), a torus in the Kerr metric, resolved MRI, horizon magnetic-flux evolution, and convergence tests are required. An attractive browser view does not replace this calculation.
